name: mt-benchmark-public
description: A public multilingual machine translation benchmark that measures translation quality across multiple language pairs and domains. It is designed to evaluate models' ability to produce fluent, accurate translations and to compare translation quality across systems. The benchmark reports automatic translation-quality metrics and supports evaluation on varied text sources.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing use; not as widely adopted as major MT benchmarks like WMT.
